# Manuel Erazo

Full stack developer in Bogotá, Colombia. Builds SaaS products, interfaces and AI systems with TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL and AWS.
Open to remote roles and freelance work. Systems Engineering graduate, Fundación Universitaria de Popayán, June 2026.

- GymRatPlus — training plans, nutrition, athlete progress, coaching, memberships and payments. Next.js, PostgreSQL and Drizzle — https://gymratplus.com
